coupon.transactional: the value travels in the call, so every recipient gets the same code
coupon.journey: insert a Dengage coupon list through Insert > Customization Tags > Coupons, so every recipient gets a code of their own and the platform marks it taken
coupon.redemption: Dengage issues a unique code per recipient and marks it taken. Applying the discount is the operator's billing system

note: A transactional send sees only these values. $Contact tags stay empty, so nothing the email prints comes from the contact record.
